messages.content: Write a paragraph using words that contain only three types of vowels. How is the architecture for a stable diffusion model specified?

message.content: The SD net is set via a spec that lists each layer's width, depth, heads, and time steps. An SD net can be a stack with resnet layers, linear heads, and MLP parts. It can set the text and image scales. It can set the latent size and shape.
